method: Grades marked "Script:" were recomputed by tools/grade.py from the packages as they are now (contrast, token provenance, the README's Do and don't list, and DESIGN.md freshness). Criteria a capture cannot meet are graded not applicable (see each criterion). Every other grade is carried over from the 2026-10-16 review: Five Sonnet agents applied the fixed rubric to each package's README, tokens, components.md and DESIGN.md, ran the library's contrast and DESIGN.md checks, and wrote one grade plus a short evidence note per criterion. Contrast results and every DESIGN.md check were re-run by hand.
